correctness.rationale: For the repaired files, the sharp equivalence is unchanged. The eligibility q≡1 mod 3 excludes p=3; in p=2 the shifts 0 and 2 coincide. For odd p the three exceptional starts are distinct, and each excluded indicator product is 0 or 9. The expanded character product has the constant q, six one-shift terms summing to zero, twelve two-shift terms of modulus at most sqrt(q), and eight three-shift terms of modulus at most 2sqrt(q). The nonzero root exponents are 1 or 2 and thus no polynomial in the latter two classes is a cube; the standard Weil bound applies over these extensions, with two or three distinct roots. This proves the uniform lower bound q−28sqrt(q)−27 for 27 times each word count, positive from q=841. Below 841 a proper prime power has prime base at most 28; generating eligible odd powers gives 25,49,121,169,289,343,361,529,625, with no others. The separate standard-library enumeration searched monic polynomials, tested all monic divisors through half their degree, constructed the quotient arithmetic, partitioned the nonzero elements into explicit cube cosets and enumerated all q−3 admissible starts in each field. The realized counts are 17,19 and then seven 27s. Minimum positive counts are 1,2,2,4,6,4,10,16,14. The frozen RESULT.md row at 49 incorrectly said 1: both certificate.json (min_positive_count=2) and the independent replay give 2 and agree on the eight missing words. The original success marker also misleadingly labeled all nine fields complete. The corrected RESULT.md, VERIFICATION.md, verify.py and verify_output.txt agree that nine were checked and seven are complete, and the corrected census agrees with the unchanged certificate; the script change is reporting-only. All frozen files were inspected and left unchanged, and the uploaded script was not executed. Replay: /workspace/branches/80bf9d4c-13dd-4379-b49b-8c336d4607d3/independent_replay.py with Python 3, no dependencies; record replay_full.txt, lines 1–10, includes the eligible fields and full summary. This checks the finite remainder, not the Weil estimate or scientific priority. The corrected public replacements have been checked for consistency with the exact proof and replay.

value.rationale: Completeness of the ordered cubic-residue language is a natural sharp finite-field threshold problem. Establishing precisely where every local pattern is available is stronger and more usable than eventual existence: the exact obstruction in characteristic two and the two small odd-field failures settle every parameter in the extension domain. The census closes the substantive gap between the first complete eligible extension at 121 and the uniform analytic guarantee at 841, and provides explicit witnesses or exhaustive obstructions there. No separate importance is attributed to the typographic multiplicity correction or the standard character bound.
